objectLoopNormalization: External relocation-qualified calls/tail transfers cannot form intra-function loops; only their printed target labels are suppressed before original cost(). All instructions/calls remain counted.
scope: Existing official pre-optimization history target objects; original15gates and limits untouched. XIP failed1592B, no target acceptance.
limits: Static instruction/loop/frame estimates, not cycles or whole-chain worst stack. Object addresses qualify duplicates. Unresolvedexternal/indirect callbacks and IRQ nesting remain unmeasured. All outlined callee work is listed; lower caller counts are not CPU improvement.
